name: Cambridge
description:
## Description

"Compact speaker system using pure natural oak.A 16cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.In addition, a 2.5cm dome type tweeter cooled by magnetic fluid is installed in the high frequency range.The enclosure uses an acoustic suspension system that has been perfected by Henry Cross for more than 30years. This system controls the diaphragm by utilizing the spring action of the air obtained by the enclosed structure, and achieves excellent bass reproduction.The enclosure is made of solid natural oak veneer and is manufactured in a piece-joint construction used for traditional furniture and other items. In addition, all corners are harmful vibrations and diffraction waves.Punching metal cover is used on the front."

name: Cambridge
description:
## Description

"A separate speaker system consisting of two satellite speakers and two subwoofers.Unlike most 3D systems, it uses a slim subwoofer with separate left and right channels, which allows for half the size of the woofer cabinet for equal performance and increased space flexibility.In addition, two sub-woofers and two satellite speakers each have a built-in crossover network, allowing for more freedom of placement.The satellite speaker and subwoofer crossover frequency is set to 140Hz.The satellite speakers have a suede touch Nextel paint gun metal gray finish.The subwoofer uses an acoustic suspension system and the exterior is a black high-pressure laminate with a metal grill."

## Description

"A portable speaker system that Henry Cross came up with while preparing for his vacation.The Model Eleven consists of amplifiers, satellite speakers and sub-woofers.The amplifier and satellite speakers can be stored in a trunk-case type subwoofer during transportation.An acoustic suspension system is used for the subwoofer.The amplifier section is designed with differential input, low noise and low distortion rate.The Route 3input is installed in this amplifier section.The power output terminal of DC9V can supply power to portable CD players.Equipped with tone control, balance volume, and stereo / mono switch."
